name: Magic Status
body:
School divination; Level cleric/oracle 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Targets one living creature touched per three levels
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as status, except that you also know the name and caster level of any spell cast upon your allies.
